# fatih guzel

> software engineer from turkey. i design and build reliable, high-performance software systems.

## about

fatih guzel is a software engineer interested in systems, distributed systems,
simplicity, abstractions, performance, product engineering, and the fundamentals
behind good engineering.

the site contains personal notes, project references, talks, work/contact information,
and writing on engineering, systems, technology, work, and the software industry.

## projects

- doom in typescript: a browser port of doom, written in typescript with three.js.
- ring3: a runtime for windows games in the browser, written in rust. it loads exe and dll files, translates x86 machine code into webassembly, and provides its own windows api layer.
- vemi: a tiny, type-safe markdown compiler used by this site's article pipeline.
- chrome dino learns to run: a neural-network demo project for chrome's offline dino game.
- mips processor from first principles: a single-cycle mips processor implementation.
- stack over papers: an open repository and community around computer science papers.
- nudge: a lightweight self-motivation daemon that sends randomized, time-blocked messages throughout the day.
- fauthy: an open-source command-line totp manager with local encryption.

## talks

- [biraz dağıtık düşünelim](https://fatihguzel.dev/talks/biraz-dagitik-dusunelim): a talk in turkish on the theoretical foundations of distributed systems.
